Alert.description: Stored as a record (kind='alert'). E.g. expected vendor file missing, SLA breach, payment due at risk.
Alert.title: Alert

caught_usd.description: USD of bills held, rejected or payment-blocked by checks

scope.description: full | undisputed (pay only the undisputed part of a hold)
full | undisputed; default: undisputed on a hold, else full

Bill.description: One invoice as the AP team sees it.

stage.description: processing | needs_review | on_hold | ready_to_pay | blocked | scheduled | paid | rejected

needs.description: role that must sign, or nobody

waiting_hours.description: time since it was handed to a human

overbilled.description: amount at risk from the 3-way match, invoice currency

credit_available.description: advance-payment credit open for this vendor

warning.description: one line shown under the bill in lists

payable.description: AP booked by the Poster and not yet credited: what a payment run may pay (the undisputed part of a partial hold)

disputed.description: held part of a hold (invoice currency)

disagreements.description: where the second-line checks and the agents' decision disagree

sub_case_ids.description: one sub-case per discrepancy, grouped here

Bill.title: Bill

invoice_bank_last4.description: the account printed on the invoice (last 4)

hours_saved_est.description: ESTIMATE, labeled as such in the UI

replans.description: Times the agent re-planned after a rejection

as_of.description: Business 'today' for this case (posting date, period locks)

assigned_to.description: Human who took over; agent stages skip while set

as_of.description: 'Today' for this case (period locks, due dates)

CheckResult.description: One pre-payment check and whether it passed, with references to the evidence.

severity.description: high | medium | low (only meaningful when not passed)

CheckResult.title: CheckResult

ContractTerm.description: Contract / amendment price. Amendment wins only from effective_from.
ContractTerm.title: ContractTerm

Controls.description: Kill switch. Stored as a record (kind='controls', key='global').
Controls.title: Controls

DashboardMetrics.description: Dashboard read model (D). C's BusinessMetrics is the eval/scoreboard model.

dollars_caught_usd.description: Held/rejected/escalated exposure, USD at simulated FX

hours_saved_estimate.description: ESTIMATE: per-case manual minutes x cases handled

on_time_payment_rate.description: Posted on or before due date; None if nothing posted

DashboardMetrics.title: DashboardMetrics

original_type.description: For below_materiality: the type it would have been (e.g. price_over)

text.description: Raw text. UNTRUSTED. Never sent to a prompt with tools.

subject.description: Email Subject header (UNTRUSTED); carries [REC <case_id>] on replies

EarlyPayOffer.description: An early-payment discount on one bill, computed in code from the vendor's terms.
EarlyPayOffer.title: EarlyPayOffer

variance.description: Expected disputed amount, to the cent

paid_amount.description: Expected undisputed amount posted (pay what's clean)

asserts.description: '<case_id>.<dotted.path>' -> expected str value, checked after this fixture

FailureItem.description: A non-ok step and what the pipeline did next.
FailureItem.title: FailureItem

Finding.description: One check the agents ran, in plain language, for the reviewer.
Finding.title: Finding

closed_by.description: Doc id / case id / person that closed it

InboundItem.description: One file as it arrived. Paths are relative to the case folder.

sender.description: Email From / SFTP account / API key owner

api_key.description: API channel only; simulated per-vendor key

InboundItem.title: InboundItem

IntakeAccepted.description: Returned by POST /intake: the run continues in the background.
IntakeAccepted.title: IntakeAccepted

bank_last4.description: Bank account on the invoice, last 4 only

credit_for.description: Credit note: invoice number it credits (amounts positive)

corrects.description: Corrected invoice: invoice number it replaces

MatchRow.description: One SKU across purchase order, goods receipt and invoice. Variances computed in code.

amount_at_risk.description: what would be overpaid, in invoice currency

MatchRow.title: MatchRow

needs.description: role that must approve: approver | controller

name.description: e.g. duplicate_tax_id, sanctions, employee_bank, lookalike_domain, tax_form

OnboardingRequest.description: data/onboarding/onb_*.json. Always started by an internal requester (vendors never self-sign-up).
OnboardingRequest.title: OnboardingRequest

line_hash.description: sha256 of sorted (sku, qty, unit_price) lines; see doc dedup

pay_to_last4.description: Always the vendor master's account, never the invoice's

gross_amount.description: invoice total before discount and credits

methods.description: case_id -> method; default by vendor country

PaymentTerms.description: Commercial terms from the contract / vendor master (never from invoice text). e.g. 2/10 net 30.

discount_days.description: pay within N days of the invoice date to earn it

prepay_discount_pct.description: discount for paying in advance, e.g. 0.04

prepay_cap_usd.description: max open prepaid balance for this vendor

PaymentTerms.title: PaymentTerms

Prepayment.description: An advance payment that buys vendor credit at a discount. SIMULATED settlement.
Prepayment.title: Prepayment

policy_recommendation.description: Floor computed by code from the decision table; recommendation may never be below it

engine.description: droid | claude | deterministic fallback | code (clean / no skill)

source_of_truth.description: Which document wins and why (kept out of explanation)

next_action.description: e.g. request a credit note via the contact on file

QueueItem.description: One open case in the approval queue, sorted by priority (highest first).

total_usd.description: At the simulated policy FX rate

at_risk.description: Due within the at-risk window or overdue

reasons.description: Why it ranks where it does

QueueItem.title: QueueItem

ReviewPacket.description: Everything the reviewer gets once the background run is done.

ready.description: False while the pipeline is still running

needs.description: who must sign: approver | controller | nobody

ReviewPacket.title: ReviewPacket

onboarding.description: Vendor-onboarding results; reported separately from the headline

notes.description: Run notes, e.g. a skipped section and why

SignOff.description: A human decision on a prepayment or onboarding request.
SignOff.title: SignOff

Signal.description: A pre-payment check run by code at review time.

code.description: bank_mismatch | lookalike_domain | duplicate | qty_short | price_over | not_on_po | over_limit | embedded_instructions | probation

Signal.title: Signal

replay_after.description: Eval summary with the proposal applied

StageStat.description: How one pipeline stage behaved across every case's latest run.
StageStat.title: StageStat

SupplierEmail.description: Outbound email to the vendor's contact on file (never reply-to-sender). SIMULATED: not actually sent.

subject.description: Carries the case reference, e.g. '[REC case_02] ...', so replies link back

SupplierEmail.title: SupplierEmail

bank_last4.description: Last 4 digits only. Never store full numbers.

contact_email.description: Verified contact on file; outbound goes here, never reply-to

VendorCheck.description: One onboarding check as shown in the UI (D): CRS or code, pass/warn/fail.
VendorCheck.title: VendorCheck
